svg.title: LizCraft thank-you card back with the original maker’s message

g.aria-label: Thank you so much for your order! Every stitch in this piece was made with
care and intention. I’m so excited for this to become a part of your wardrobe.
When you wear lizcraft, you’re supporting a dream and the art of handmade
craft. I hope you love wearing it as much as I loved creating it.
